title: Changes in Traffic-Related Air Pollution Exposures and Associations With Adverse Birth Outcomes Over 20 Years in Texas
abstract:
Billions of dollars have been spent implementing regulations to reduce traffic-related air pollution (TRAP) from exhaust pipe emissions. However, few health studies have evaluated the change in TRAP emissions and associations with infant health outcomes. We hypothesize that the magnitude of association between vehicle exposure measures and adverse birth outcomes has decreased over time, parallelling regulatory improvements in exhaust pipe emissions.
Using birth records in Texas from 1996 to 2016, we calculated residential exposure measures related to TRAP: nitrogen dioxide (NO2, a marker of the TRAP mixture), vehicle miles travelled within 500 m of homes (VMT500), a measure of traffic volume, and highway proximity. Using an accountability study framework, our analysis examined term birthweight, term low birthweight (TLBW) (<2500 g), preterm birth (PTB) (<37 weeks) and very preterm birth (VPTB) (<32 weeks). We implemented linear and logistic regression models to examine overall and time-stratified associations, including trends by race/ethnicity and socioeconomic groups.
Among exposures for 6 158 518 births, NO2 exposures decreased 59% over time but VMT500 remained relatively stable. TRAP-related exposure measures were persistently associated with harmful birth outcomes [e.g. OR1996-2016 of 1.07 (95% CI: 1.04, 1.08) for TLBW comparing the highest vs lowest NO2 quintile]. The magnitude of associations decreased for total VMT500 and TLBW (-60%, OR1996: 1.08 to OR2016: 1.03 for the highest vs lowest quintile) and PTB (-65%) and VTPT (-61%), but not for term birthweight.
We observed evidence of small improvements in birth outcomes associated with reductions in exhaust pipe emissions over a 20-year period in Texas.
abstract_zh:
数十亿美元已被用于实施减少尾气排放所致交通相关空气污染（TRAP）的法规。然而，很少有健康研究评估TRAP排放的变化及其与婴儿健康结局的关联。我们假设，车辆暴露指标与不良出生结局之间关联的强度随时间下降，这与尾气排放的监管改善相平行。
利用1996年至2016年德克萨斯州的出生记录，我们计算了与TRAP相关的居住暴露指标：二氧化氮（NO2，TRAP混合物的标志物）、住所500米范围内的车辆行驶里程（VMT500，一种交通量指标），以及靠近高速公路的程度。我们采用问责研究框架，考察了足月出生体重、足月低出生体重（TLBW）（<2500 g）、早产（PTB）（<37周）以及极早早产（VPTB）（<32周）。我们采用线性和逻辑回归模型，考察总体及按时间分层的关联，包括按种族/族裔和社会经济群体的趋势。
在6158518例出生的暴露数据中，NO2暴露量随时间下降了59%，而VMT500相对保持稳定。与TRAP相关的暴露指标持续与有害的出生结局相关 [例如，对于TLBW，比较NO2最高与最低五分位数，1996—2016年的OR为1.07（95% CI：1.04，1.08）]。对于总VMT500和TLBW，关联的强度下降了60%（最高与最低五分位数的OR从1996年的1.08降至2016年的1.03）；早产（PTB）下降65%，极早早产（VTPT）下降61%，但足月出生体重未下降。
我们观察到，在德克萨斯州20年间，随着尾气排放的减少，出生结局出现了小幅改善的证据。

Negotiations of Oil and Gas Auxiliary Lease Clauses: Evidence from Pennsylvania's Marcellus Shale
abstract: Oil and gas lease negotiations provide mineral owners the opportunity to negotiate for both compensation and auxiliary clauses that may protect their health and properties. We use optical character recognition to assemble a novel dataset of compensation and specific clauses in nearly 60,000 leases signed in the Marcellus Shale Play of Pennsylvania. We leverage the dataset to produce three main findings. First, contrary to the standard utility maximization model, we find a positive relationship between compensation and clauses. Second, we find that as development of the shale play progressed over time, compensation rose and leases became more likely to contain environmentally protective clauses. Third, we find that compensation and the presence of clauses have a weak relationship with the geologic productivity of nearby wells. Together, our findings indicate that oil and gas firms simultaneously make concessions by raising compensation and approving clauses, but these concessions do not depend on geologic productivity. This suggests that some mineral owners, such as those that are high-income or from more socially organized communities, have the skills or resources to negotiate for more favorable leases all-around and point to similar environmental justice concerns identified in other shale plays.
abstract_zh: 油气租赁谈判为矿产所有者提供了机会，使其能够就补偿以及可能保护其健康与财产的附属条款进行协商。我们利用光学字符识别技术，构建了一个新的数据集，涵盖宾夕法尼亚州马塞勒斯页岩区内签订的近6万份租约中的补偿及具体条款。我们利用该数据集得出了三项主要发现。第一，与标准的效用最大化模型相反，我们发现补偿与条款之间存在正相关关系。第二，随着页岩区开发的推进，补偿金额上升，租约也更可能包含具有环境保护性质的条款。第三，补偿及条款的存在与附近油井的地质生产率之间关系较弱。综合来看，我们的发现表明，油气企业同时作出让步：既提高补偿，又同意相关条款，但这些让步并不取决于地质生产率。这表明，一些矿产所有者（例如高收入者，或来自社会组织更为紧密社区的所有者）具备谈判更有利整体租约的技能或资源，并指向了在其他页岩区也已发现的类似环境正义问题。

Roadway Construction as a Natural Experiment to Examine Air Pollution Impacts on Infant Health
abstract: Traffic-related air pollution (TRAP) poses a significant public health risk that is associated with adverse birth outcomes. Large roadway infrastructure projects present a natural experiment to examine how resulting congestion change is associated with adverse birth outcomes for nearby populations. This study is designed to examine the influence of living close to a roadway before, during, and after a construction project using a difference-in-differences design. We integrated data on all large roadway construction projects (defined as widening of existing roads, building new roads, improving bridges, installing intelligent transportation systems, improving intersections, and installing or upgrading traffic signals) in Texas from 2007 to 2016 with Vital Statistic data for all births with residential addresses within 1 km of construction projects. Our outcomes included term low birth weight, term birth weight, preterm birth, and very preterm birth. Using a difference-in-differences design, we included births within 3 years of construction start and 2 years of construction end. In our main model, the exposed group is limited to pregnant individuals residing within 300 m of a construction project, and the control group includes those living within 300-1000 m from a project. We used regression models to estimate the influence of construction on infant health. We included 1,360 large roadway construction projects linked to 408,979 births. During construction, we found that the odds of term low birth weight increased by 19% (95% CI: 1.05, 1.36). However, we saw little evidence of an association for other birth outcomes. Contrary to our hypothesis of decreased TRAP after construction ends, we did not observe consistent improvements post-construction for pregnant individuals living within 300 m. Continued consideration of the influence of traffic congestion programs on birth outcomes is necessary to inform future policy decisions.
abstract_zh: 道路建设作为自然实验，考察空气污染对婴儿健康的影响。交通相关空气污染（TRAP）对公共健康构成重大风险，并与不良出生结局相关。大型道路基础设施项目为考察交通拥堵变化如何与周边人群的不良出生结局相关提供了一个自然实验。本研究采用双重差分设计，考察在道路建设项目开工前、施工期间和竣工后，居住在道路附近对孕产结局的影响。我们整合了2007至2016年得克萨斯州所有大型道路建设项目的数据（定义为既有道路拓宽、新建道路、桥梁改造、智能交通系统安装、路口改善，以及交通信号灯安装或升级），并与居住地址位于建设项目1公里范围内的所有出生的生命统计数据相匹配。我们的结局变量包括足月低出生体重、足月出生体重、早产和极早产。采用双重差分设计，我们纳入了建设开工前3年至竣工后2年内的出生数据。在主要模型中，暴露组限于居住在建设项目300米范围内的孕妇，对照组则包括居住在距项目300至1000米范围内的孕妇。我们使用回归模型估计建设对婴儿健康的影响。我们纳入了与408,979例出生相关联的1,360个大型道路建设项目。在施工期间，我们发现足月低出生体重的发生比增加了19%（95% CI：1.05，1.36）。然而，我们几乎没有发现其他出生结局存在关联的证据。与我们关于道路竣工后TRAP下降的假设相反，对于居住在300米范围内的孕妇，我们未观察到竣工后持续改善的情况。有必要持续考察交通拥堵治理项目对出生结局的影响，以为未来的政策决策提供依据。

title: The Impact of Oil and Gas Extraction on Infant Health
abstract: The benefits and costs of resource extraction are currently being hotly debated in the case of unconventional natural gas development (commonly known as “fracking”). Colorado provides a unique research environment to study the health impacts of conventional and unconventional forms of oil and gas development (OGD) given its long history of conventional OGD and recent expansion of unconventional OGD. I utilize detailed vital statistics and the mother’s residential address to define proximity to drilling activity. Using a difference-in-differences model that compares mothers residing within 1 km to mothers residing 1–5 km of a well (before and during/after drilling), I find that proximity to wells before birth increases adverse birth outcomes and pregnancy-related complications. I find impacts on the extensive and intensive margins and across well types. I also present results suggesting no impacts on fertility or mobility. These results are robust to multiple specifications and suggest that policies to mitigate against the risks of living near oil and gas development may be warranted.
abstract_zh: 石油和天然气开采对婴儿健康的影响。资源开采的收益与成本目前在非常规天然气开发（通常称为“水力压裂”）问题上存在激烈争论。科罗拉多州为研究常规和非常规石油天然气开发（OGD）的健康影响提供了独特的研究环境，因为该州拥有悠久的常规油气开发历史，且近期非常规油气开发规模迅速扩大。我利用详细的生命统计数据和母亲的居住地址来界定与钻井活动的邻近程度。采用双重差分模型，比较居住在井场1公里范围内的母亲与居住在1至5公里范围内的母亲（钻井前及钻井期间/之后），我发现，出生前居住在井附近会增加不良出生结局和妊娠相关并发症的发生。我发现其影响存在于扩展边际和集约边际上，并且在不同类型的井之间均存在。我还提供了结果，表明对生育率或人口流动性没有影响。这些结果在多种设定下均稳健，表明为降低居住在油气开发附近的风险，可能有必要制定相应政策。

title: Who is Pregnant? Defining Real-World Data-Based Pregnancy Episodes in the National COVID Cohort Collaborative (N3C)
A Population-Based Cohort Study of Electronic Tolling, Traffic Congestion, and Adverse Birth Outcomes
abstract: BACKGROUND: Although traffic-related air pollution is largely regulated at the federal level, congestion reduction projects may reduce local traffic and air pollution to levels that create positive co-benefits for population health. In recent years, many urban areas have implemented electronic tolling systems to improve traffic conditions. OBJECTIVE: Quantify associations between implementing electronic tolling and local changes in traffic and infant health. METHODS: Using a population-based birth cohort (Texas, 1999-2016), we calculated residential proximity to the nearest tolled road segment within 5 km (n = 625,279) and examined changes in local traffic before and after toll implementation. Using a difference-in-differences design, we compared four markers of adverse birth outcomes (term birth weight, term low birth weight, preterm birth, very preterm birth) among infants from pregnant people residing < 0.5 km from a road segment before and after the tolls were implemented and compared them to a contemporaneous population of pregnant people residing at 2-5 km. RESULTS: We observed minimal changes in local traffic after the implementation of tolling. Among births within 500 m of a tolled road, we found little evidence of an association between the implementation of tolling and adverse birth outcomes (term birth weight [β: -4.5, 95 % CI: -11.7, 2.6], term low birth weight [OR: 1.00, 95 % CI: 0.89, 1.13], preterm birth [OR: 0.99, 95 % CI: 0.92, 1.05], very preterm birth [OR: 1.00, 95 % CI: 0.84, 1.18]), compared to the contemporaneous control group of births at 2-5 km. In sub-analyses, we found some evidence of a reduced association between toll booth removal and preterm birth (OR: 0.84, 95 % CI: 0.70, 1.01) but not for other outcomes or tolling types. DISCUSSION: In this large population-based retrospective cohort study of births in Texas, we found little evidence that the implementation of tolling was consistently associated with improvements in local infant health outcomes.
abstract_zh: 基于人群的队列研究：电子收费、交通拥堵与不良出生结局。背景：尽管交通相关空气污染在很大程度上由联邦层面监管，但拥堵缓解项目可能会降低当地交通量和空气污染水平，从而为人群健康带来正向的协同效益。近年来，许多城市地区已实施电子收费系统以改善交通状况。目的：量化电子收费的实施与当地交通及婴儿健康变化之间的关联。方法：利用基于人群的出生队列（得克萨斯州，1999至2016年），我们计算了居住地与5公里范围内最近收费路段的邻近程度（n = 625,279），并考察了收费实施前后当地交通的变化。采用双重差分设计，我们比较了四项不良出生结局指标（足月出生体重、足月低出生体重、早产、极早产），比较对象为居住在距路段小于0.5公里的孕妇在收费实施前后所生的婴儿，以及同期居住在2至5公里范围内的孕妇人群。结果：我们观察到收费实施后当地交通的变化极小。在距收费道路500米以内的出生中，与同期2至5公里的对照组相比，我们几乎没有发现收费实施与不良出生结局之间存在关联的证据（足月出生体重[β：-4.5，95% CI：-11.7，2.6]，足月低出生体重[OR：1.00，95% CI：0.89，1.13]，早产[OR：0.99，95% CI：0.92，1.05]，极早产[OR：1.00，95% CI：0.84，1.18]）。在子分析中，我们发现收费站拆除与早产之间存在一定的关联减弱证据（OR：0.84，95% CI：0.70，1.01），但其他结局或收费类型未见此类证据。讨论：在这项针对得克萨斯州出生情况的大规模回顾性人群队列研究中，我们几乎没有发现收费的实施与当地婴儿健康结局的持续改善之间存在一致关联。

title: Air Quality Impacts of Shale Gas Development in Pennsylvania
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 2023
abstract: We estimate the impact of shale gas development on particulate matter pollution using a quasi-experimental setting in Pennsylvania where some wells were developed to produce natural gas whereas other wells were permitted but not drilled. In doing so, we utilize a novel empirical approach drawing upon insights from atmospheric chemistry to account for windblown pollution spillovers in a difference-in-differences framework. Utilizing a high frequency, high resolution satellite-based measure of PM pollution between 2000 and 2018, we identify causal increases in PM2.5 concentration ranging from 0.017 μg/m3 to 0.062 μg/m3 in the vicinity of over 20,000 wells, resulting in approximately 20 additional deaths between 2010 and 2017.
abstract_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州页岩气开发对空气质量的影响。我们利用宾夕法尼亚州的一个准实验情境来估计页岩气开发对颗粒物污染的影响，在该情境中，部分井已投入开采天然气，而另一些已获许可但未钻探的井则作为对照。在此过程中，我们采用了一种新颖的实证方法，借鉴大气化学的见解，在双重差分框架下考虑风吹污染的溢出效应。利用2000至2018年高频率、高分辨率的卫星颗粒物污染测量数据，我们识别出在20,000余口井附近PM2.5浓度的因果性上升，幅度为0.017 μg/m3至0.062 μg/m3，这导致2010至2017年间约增加20例死亡。

title: Associations Among Historical Neighborhood Disinvestment, Hazardous Air Pollutants, and Current Adult Asthma Prevalence
Changes in Socioeconomic Disparities for Traffic-Related Air Pollution Exposure During Pregnancy Over a 20-year Period in Texas
abstract:
Air pollution presents clear environmental justice issues. However, few studies have specifically examined traffic-related air pollution (TRAP), a source driven by historically racist infrastructure policies, among pregnant individuals, a population susceptible to air pollution effects. How these disparities have changed over time is also unclear but has important policy implications.
To examine changes in TRAP exposure by sociodemographic characteristics among recorded pregnancies over a 20-year period.
This population-based birth cohort study used descriptive analysis among pregnant individuals in Texas from 1996 to 2016. All pregnant individuals with valid residential address, socioeconomic, and demographic data were included. Individual-level race and ethnicity, education, and maternal birthplace data were extracted from birth certificates and neighborhood-level household income and historical neighborhood disinvestment (ie, redlining) data were assessed via residential addresses. Data analysis occurred between June 2022 and June 2023.
The main outcome, TRAP exposure at residential addresses, was assessed via traffic levels, represented by total and truck-specific vehicle miles traveled (VMT) within 500 m; nitrogen dioxide (no2) concentrations from a spatial-temporal land use regression model (ie, vehicle tailpipe emissions); and National Air Toxic Agency cancer risk index from on-road vehicle emissions. TRAP exposure differences were assessed by sociodemographic indicators over the 1996 to 2016 period.
Among 7 043 598 pregnant people (mean [SD] maternal age, 26.8 [6.1] years) in Texas from 1996 to 2016, 48% identified as Hispanic or Latinx, 4% identified as non-Hispanic Asian or Pacific Islander, 12% identified as non-Hispanic Black, and 36% identified as non-Hispanic White. There were differences in TRAP for pregnant people by all sociodemographic variables examined. The absolute level of these disparities decreased from 1996 to 2016, but the relative level of these disparities increased: for example, in 1996, non-Hispanic Black pregnant individuals were exposed to a mean (SD) 15.3 (4.1) ppb of no2 vs 13.5 (4.4) ppb of no2 for non-Hispanic White pregnant individuals, compared with 2016 levels of 6.7 (2.4) ppb no2 for Black pregnant individuals and 5.2 (2.4) ppb of no2 for White pregnant individuals. Large absolute and relative differences in traffic levels were observed for all sociodemographic characteristics, increasing over time. For example, non-Hispanic Black pregnant individuals were exposed to a mean (SD) of 22 836 (32 844) VMT within 500 m of their homes, compared with 12 478 (22 870) VMT within 500 m of the homes of non-Hispanic White pregnant individuals in 2016, a difference of 83%.
This birth cohort study found that while levels of air pollution disparities decreased in absolute terms over the 20 years of the study, relative disparities persisted and large differences in traffic levels remained, requiring renewed policy attention.
abstract_zh:
孕期交通相关空气污染暴露社会经济差距的变化。空气污染引发了明确的环境正义问题。然而，很少有研究专门考察孕妇群体中的交通相关空气污染（TRAP）问题，而TRAP的源头是历史上种族主义基础设施政策所驱动的，孕妇又是对空气污染影响尤为敏感的人群。这些差距如何随时间变化同样尚不清楚，但其具有重要的政策意义。
目的：考察20年间登记妊娠中，TRAP暴露按社会人口学特征的变化情况。
设计、背景与参与者：本基于人群的出生队列研究，采用描述性分析，研究对象为1996至2016年间得克萨斯州的孕妇。所有具有有效居住地址、社会经济和人口学数据的孕妇均被纳入。个体层面的种族与族裔、教育程度和母亲出生地信息取自出生证明；社区层面的家庭收入和历史性社区衰败（即红线政策）数据则根据居住地址获取。数据分析时间为2022年6月至2023年6月。
主要结局指标：居住地址处的TRAP暴露，通过以下方式测量：500米范围内的总车辆行驶里程（VMT）和卡车专用车辆行驶里程所代表的交通量；基于时空土地利用回归模型得出的二氧化氮（NO2）浓度（即车辆尾气排放）；以及来自道路机动车排放的美国国家空气有毒物质癌症风险指数。TRAP暴露差异按社会人口学指标在1996至2016年间进行评估。
结果：在1996至2016年间得克萨斯州的7,043,598名孕妇中（母亲平均年龄（标准差）为26.8（6.1）岁），48%为西班牙裔或拉丁裔，4%为非西班牙裔亚裔或太平洋岛民，12%为非西班牙裔黑人，36%为非西班牙裔白人。所考察的每项社会人口学变量下，孕妇的TRAP暴露均存在差异。这些差距的绝对水平在1996至2016年间有所下降，但相对水平有所上升：例如，1996年，非西班牙裔黑人孕妇的NO2平均（标准差）暴露为15.3（4.1）ppb，非西班牙裔白人孕妇为13.5（4.4）ppb；而到2016年，黑人孕妇的NO2水平为6.7（2.4）ppb，白人孕妇为5.2（2.4）ppb。对于所有社会人口学特征，交通量的绝对和相对差异均较大，且随时间扩大。例如，2016年，非西班牙裔黑人孕妇居所500米范围内的平均（标准差）VMT为22,836（32,844），而非西班牙裔白人孕妇为12,478（22,870），差异达83%。
结论与意义：这项出生队列研究发现，在研究的20年间，空气污染差距的绝对水平有所下降，但相对差距依然存在，且交通量的巨大差异仍然存在，需要重新予以政策关注。

Drinking Water Contaminant Concentrations and Birth Outcomes
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management, 2023
abstract: Previous research in the U.S. has found negative health effects of contamination when it triggers regulatory violations. An important question is whether levels of contamination that do not trigger a health‐based violation impact health. We study the impact of drinking water contamination in community water systems on birth outcomes using drinking water sampling results data in Pennsylvania. We focus on the effects of water contamination for births not exposed to regulatory violations. Our most rigorous specification employs mother fixed effects and finds changing from the 10th to the 90th percentile of water contamination (among births not exposed to regulatory violations) increases low birth weight by 12% and preterm birth by 17%.
abstract_zh: 饮用水污染物浓度与出生结局。既有美国研究发现，当污染触发监管违规时，会产生负面健康效应。一个重要问题是，未触发基于健康的违规标准的污染水平是否会影响健康。我们利用宾夕法尼亚州的饮用水采样监测数据，研究社区供水系统中饮用水污染对出生结局的影响。我们聚焦于未暴露于监管违规的出生人群中水污染的影响。我们最为严谨的设定采用母亲固定效应，发现对于未暴露于监管违规的出生人群，水污染浓度从第10百分位数变化至第90百分位数，低出生体重增加12%，早产增加17%。

title: Is the Emergency Department a Substitute for or a Complement to Primary Care in Medicaid?
Multiple Dimensions of Environmental Justice and Oil and Gas Development in Pennsylvania
abstract:
Community socioeconomic deprivation (CSD) may be related to higher oil and natural gas development (OGD) exposure. We tested for distributive and benefit-sharing environmental injustice in Pennsylvania's Marcellus Shale by examining (1) whether OGD and waste disposal occurred disproportionately in more deprived communities and (2) discordance between the location of land leased for OGD and where oil and gas rights owners resided.
Analyses took place at the county subdivision level and considered OGD wells, waste disposal, and land lease agreement locations from 2005 to 2019. Using 2005–2009 American Community Survey data, we created a CSD index relevant to community vulnerability in suburban/rural areas.
In adjusted regression models accounting for spatial dependence, we observed no association between the CSD index and conventional or unconventional drilled well presence. However, a higher CSD index was linearly associated with odds of a subdivision having an OGD waste disposal site and receiving a larger volume of waste. A higher percentage of oil and gas rights owners lived in the same county subdivision as leased land when the community was least versus most deprived (66% vs. 56% in same county subdivision), suggesting that individuals in more deprived communities were less likely to financially benefit from OGD exposure.
We observed distributive environmental injustice with respect to well waste disposal and benefit-sharing environmental injustice related to oil and rights owner's residential locations across Pennsylvania's Marcellus Shale. These results add evidence of a disparity between exposure and benefits resulting from OGD.
abstract_zh:
宾夕法尼亚州环境正义的多重维度与油气开发。社区社会经济剥夺（CSD）可能与更高的石油和天然气开发（OGD）暴露相关。我们在宾夕法尼亚州马塞勒斯页岩区检验了分配性和利益分享性环境不公，考察了：（1）油气开发和废物处置是否不成比例地发生在更为贫困的社区；以及（2）油气开发用地的租赁地点与油气权利所有者居住地之间的不一致。
方法：分析在县辖区（county subdivision）层面进行，考虑了2005至2019年的油气开发井、废物处置点和土地租赁协议地点。利用2005至2009年的美国社区调查数据，我们构建了与郊区/农村地区社区脆弱性相关的社区社会经济剥夺指数。
结果：在考虑空间依赖性的调整回归模型中，我们未观察到社区社会经济剥夺指数与常规或非常规钻井的存在之间存在关联。然而，社区社会经济剥夺指数越高，县辖区内存在油气废物处置点并接收更大废物量的发生比越高，二者呈线性关系。当社区处于最不贫困与最贫困时，居住在与租赁土地位于同一县辖区内的油气权利所有者比例分别为66%与56%，这表明较贫困社区的居民从油气开发暴露中获得经济利益的可能性较低。
结论：我们在宾夕法尼亚州马塞勒斯页岩区观察到，废物处置方面存在分配性环境不公，以及与权利所有者居住地相关的利益分享性环境不公。这些结果为油气开发中暴露与收益之间的不平等提供了更多证据。

title: Risk Factors Associated with Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2: An N3C and NIH RECOVER Study
A Population-Based Cohort Study of Traffic Congestion and Infant Growth Using Connected Vehicle Data
abstract: More than 11 million Americans reside within 150 meters of a highway, an area of high air pollution exposure. Traffic congestion further contributes to environmental pollution (e.g., air and noise), but its unique importance for population health is unclear. We hypothesized that degraded environmental quality specifically from traffic congestion has harmful impacts on fetal growth. Using a population-based cohort of births in Texas (2015–2016), we leveraged connected vehicle data to calculate traffic congestion metrics around each maternal address at delivery. Among 579,122 births, we found consistent adverse associations between traffic congestion and reduced term birth weight (8.9 grams), even after accounting for sociodemographic characteristics, typical traffic volume, and diverse environmental coexposures. We estimated that up to 1.2 million pregnancies annually may be exposed to traffic congestion (27% of births in the United States), with ~256,000 in the highest congestion zones. Therefore, improvements to traffic congestion may yield positive cobenefits for infant health.
abstract_zh: 基于人群的队列研究：利用网联车辆数据考察交通拥堵与婴儿生长。美国有超过1100万人居住在距高速公路150米范围内，该区域的空气污染暴露水平较高。交通拥堵进一步加剧了环境污染（如空气和噪声污染），但其对人群健康的独特重要性尚不明确。我们假设，交通拥堵所造成的环境质量恶化会对胎儿生长产生有害影响。利用得克萨斯州2015至2016年的基于人群的出生队列，我们利用网联车辆数据，计算了分娩时每个母亲住址周围的交通拥堵指标。在579,122例出生中，我们发现交通拥堵与足月出生体重降低（8.9克）之间存在一致的不利关联，即使在考虑社会人口学特征、典型交通量以及多种环境共同暴露因素之后，该关联依然存在。我们估计，每年最多有120万例妊娠可能暴露于交通拥堵之下（占美国出生人数的27%），其中约256,000例位于拥堵最严重的区域。因此，改善交通拥堵可能为婴儿健康带来正向的协同效益。

title: A Systematic Review of Geospatial Representation of United States Community Water Systems
abstract: This study presents a state‐level systematic review of geospatial representation of Community Water Systems (CWSs) in the United States. We conducted online searches and contacted government, water industry, and academic representatives to obtain these data. CWS geospatial data were characterized by vector type, methodological approaches, data sources, availability to the public, entities involved in creation and maintenance of data, and CWS map requirements by primacy agency. We found that 24 states and the District of Columbia had geospatial representation of CWS estimated service area boundary (ESAB) (i.e., polygons), which were harmonized to construct a geospatial database representative of available CWS ESABs. Our findings aim to prompt discussion among myriad stakeholders on the need to create, standardize, and maintain CWS ESABs to ensure water justice for all communities.
abstract_zh: 美国社区供水系统地理空间表征的系统综述。本研究对美国社区供水系统（CWS）地理空间表征进行了州一级的系统综述。我们进行了在线检索，并联系了政府、水务行业和学术界的代表以获取这些数据。我们依据矢量类型、方法路径、数据来源、公众可获取性、数据创建与维护的相关机构，以及各主管机构对CWS地图的要求，对CWS地理空间数据进行了特征描述。我们发现，有24个州和哥伦比亚特区拥有CWS预估服务区边界（ESAB）（即多边形）的地理空间表征，我们对这些数据进行了统一处理，构建了一个代表现有CWS ESAB的地理空间数据库。我们的研究结果旨在促使各利益相关方讨论创建、标准化和维护CWS ESAB的必要性，以确保所有社区的水资源公正。

Where You Drink Water: An Assessment of the Tennessee, USA Public Water Supply
abstract: Monitoring drinking water quality is essential to protect people’s health and wellbeing. In the United States, the Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS) database records the occurrence of a drinking water violation regulation in public water systems. A notable shortcoming of SDWIS is the lack of the contaminant concentration level about the allowable maximum contaminant threshold. In this study, we take advantage of both the SDWIS violation database and the contaminants sampling database at the state level to examine the drinking water quality of all kinds of drinking water systems in detail. We obtained sampling data (i.e., the concentration level of contaminants) of public water systems (PWSs) in Tennessee and explored the statistical distribution of contaminant concentration data in relation to the enforceable maximum regulatory contaminant level). We use both SDWIS violation records and actual concentrations of contaminants from the sampling data to study the factors that influence the drinking water quality of PWSs. We find that different types of violations were more frequent in (1) specific geological regions, (2) counties with PWSs that serve a larger population (10,000 to 100,000 people), and (3) places with abundant surface water, such as near a lake or major river. Additionally, the distribution of measured concentrations for many contaminants was not smooth but was punctuated by discontinuities at selected levels, such as at 50% of the maximum contaminant level. Such anomalies in the sampling data do not indicate violations, but more investigation is needed to determine the reasons behind the punctuated changes.
abstract_zh: 你喝的水如何？对田纳西州美国公共供水的评估。监测饮用水质量对于保护人们的健康和福祉至关重要。在美国，安全饮用水信息系统（SDWIS）数据库记录了公共供水系统中饮用水违规监管的发生情况。SDWIS的一个明显不足是缺乏污染物浓度水平与允许最高污染物限值之间的对照信息。在本研究中，我们同时利用州一级的SDWIS违规数据库和污染物采样数据库，详细考察各类饮用水系统的水质。我们获取了田纳西州公共供水系统（PWS）的采样数据（即污染物浓度水平），并探讨了污染物浓度数据与可执行的最高监管污染物限值之间的统计分布。我们同时利用SDWIS违规记录和采样数据中的实际污染物浓度，研究影响PWS水质的因素。我们发现，不同类型的违规在以下情况中更为频繁：（1）特定地质区域，（2）服务人口较多（1万至10万人）的PWS所在县，以及（3）地表水丰富的地区，例如湖泊或大河附近。此外，许多污染物的实测浓度分布并不平滑，而是在某些水平处出现不连续点，例如在最高污染物限值的50%处。采样数据中的此类异常并不表示违规，但需要进一步研究以确定这些阶跃式变化的原因。

Associations Between Residential Proximity to Oil and Gas Extraction and Hypertensive Conditions During Pregnancy: A Difference-in-Differences Analysis in Texas, 1996-2009
abstract:
Oil and gas extraction produces air pollutants that are associated with increased risks of hypertension. To date, no study has examined residential proximity to oil and gas extraction and hypertensive conditions during pregnancy. This study quantifies associations between residential proximity to oil and gas development on gestational hypertension and eclampsia.
We utilized a population-based retrospective birth cohort in Texas (1996–2009), where mothers reside 1–2 or >2–3 km) or far (≥3–10 km) from an active or future drilling site.
Among pregnant women residing 0–1 km from an active oil or gas extraction site, we estimate 5% increased odds of gestational hypertension [95% confidence interval (CI): 1.00, 1.10] and 26% increased odds of eclampsia (95% CI: 1.05, 1.51) in adjusted models. This association dissipates in the 1- to 3-km buffer zones. In restricted models, we find elevated odds ratios among maternal ages ≤35 years at delivery, maternal non-Hispanic White race, ≥30 lbs gained during pregnancy, nulliparous mothers and maternal educational attainment beyond high school.
Living within 1 km of an oil or gas extraction site during pregnancy is associated with increased odds of hypertensive conditions during pregnancy.
abstract_zh:
石油和天然气开采会排放与高血压风险增加相关的空气污染物。迄今为止，尚无研究考察居住地与石油和天然气开采设施的距离与孕期高血压状况之间的关系。本研究量化了居住地靠近石油和天然气开发设施与妊娠期高血压及子痫之间的关联。
我们利用德克萨斯州基于人口的回顾性出生队列数据（1996–2009年），其中母亲的居住地距离活跃或未来钻井场较近（1–2 或 >2–3 km）或较远（≥3–10 km）。
在孕期居住于距离活跃石油或天然气开采场地0–1 km的孕妇中，经调整模型估计，妊娠期高血压的发生几率增加5%［95%置信区间（CI）：1.00，1.10］，子痫的发生几率增加26%（95% CI：1.05，1.51）。这一关联在1至3 km的缓冲区内消失。在限制性模型中，我们发现以下人群的比值比较高：分娩时母亲年龄≤35岁、非西班牙裔白人母亲、孕期体重增加≥30磅、初产妇，以及受教育程度高于高中的母亲。
孕期居住在活跃石油或天然气开采场地1 km以内，与孕期高血压状况的发生几率增加相关。

title: Associations between Residential Proximity to Oil and Gas Drilling and Term Birth Weight and Small-for-Gestational-Age Infants in Texas: A Difference-in-Differences Analysis
abstract: Background: Oil and natural gas extraction may produce environmental pollution at levels that affect reproductive health of nearby populations. Available studies have primarily focused on unconventional gas drilling and have not accounted for local population changes that can coincide with drilling activity. Objective: Our study sought to examine associations between residential proximity to oil and gas drilling and adverse term birth outcomes using a difference-in-differences study design. Methods: We created a retrospective population-based term birth cohort in Texas between 1996 and 2009 composed of mother–infant dyads (n=2,598,025) living <10km from an oil or gas site. We implemented a difference-in-differences approach to estimate associations between drilling activities and infant health: term birth weight and term small for gestational age (SGA). Using linear and logistic regression, we modeled interactions between births before (unexposed) or during (exposed) drilling activity and residential proximity near (0–1, 1–2, or 2–3km) or far (3–10km) from an active or future drilling site, adjusting for individual- and neighborhood-level characteristics. Results: The adjusted mean difference in term birth weight for mothers living 0–1 vs. 3–10km from a current or future drilling site was –7.3g [95% confidence interval (CI): –11.6, –3.0] for births during active vs. future drilling. The corresponding adjusted odds ratio for SGA was 1.02 (95% CI: 0.98, 1.06). Negative associations with term birth weight were observed for the 1–2 and 2–3km near groups, and no consistent differences were identified by type of drilling activity. Larger, though imprecise, adverse associations were found for infants born to Hispanic women, women with the lowest educational attainment, and women living in cities. Conclusions: Residing near oil and gas drilling sites during pregnancy was associated with a small reduction in term birth weight but not SGA, with some evidence of environmental injustices. Additional work is needed to investigate specific drilling-related exposures that might explain these associations. https://doi.org/10.1289/EHP7678
abstract_zh: 居住地邻近油气钻井与足月出生体重及小于胎龄儿之间的关联。背景：石油和天然气开采可能产生环境污染，其水平可能影响附近人群的生殖健康。现有研究主要关注非常规天然气钻井，且未考虑可能与钻井活动同时发生的当地人口变化。目的：本研究旨在采用双重差分研究设计，考察居住地邻近油气钻井与不良足月出生结局之间的关联。方法：我们在得克萨斯州构建了一个1996至2009年的回顾性、基于人群的足月出生队列，由居住在距油气井小于10公里范围内的母婴对（n=2,598,025）组成。我们采用双重差分方法，估计钻井活动与婴儿健康（足月出生体重和足月小于胎龄儿（SGA））之间的关联。我们利用线性和逻辑回归，对出生于钻井活动之前（未暴露）或期间（暴露）的情况与居住地邻近程度之间的交互作用进行建模，邻近程度分为近距离（0–1、1–2或2–3公里）或远距离（3–10公里）距活跃或未来钻井点的距离，并对个体和社区层面的特征进行了调整。结果：对于居住在距当前或未来钻井点0至1公里与3至10公里的母亲，在活跃钻井期间与未来钻井期间出生的婴儿相比，足月出生体重的调整平均差值为–7.3克［95%置信区间（CI）：–11.6，–3.0］。SGA对应的调整发生比为1.02（95% CI：0.98，1.06）。在1至2公里和2至3公里的近距离组中观察到与足月出生体重的负相关，且在钻井活动类型之间未发现一致差异。西班牙裔女性、受教育程度最低的女性以及居住在城市的女性所生婴儿的不利关联更大，但估计不够精确。结论：孕期居住在油气钻井点附近，与足月出生体重的小幅下降相关，但与SGA无关，并有部分证据表明存在环境不公。需要进一步研究，以探讨可能解释这些关联的具体钻井相关暴露因素。https://doi.org/10.1289/EHP7678

title: Clinical Characterization and Prediction of Clinical Severity of SARS-CoV-2 Infection Among US Adults Using Data From the US National COVID Cohort Collaborative
Economic, Environmental, and Health Impacts of the Fracking Boom
abstract: The shale gas boom revolutionized the energy sector through hydraulic fracturing (fracking). High levels of energy production force communities, states, and nations to consider the externalities and potential risks associated with this unconventional oil and natural gas development (UOGD). In this review, we systematically outline the environmental, economic, and anthropogenic impacts of UOGD, while also considering the diverse methodological approaches to these topics. We summarize the current status and conclusions of the academic literature, in both economic and related fields, while also providing suggested avenues for future research. Causal inference will continue to be important for the evaluation of UOGD costs and benefits. We conclude that current economic, global, and health forces may require researchers to revisit outcomes in the face of a potential shale bust.
abstract_zh: 水力压裂热潮的经济、环境与健康影响。页岩气热潮通过水力压裂（即“水力压裂”）彻底改变了能源行业。高水平的能源生产迫使社区、州和国家考虑这种非常规石油和天然气开发（UOGD）所带来的外部性和潜在风险。在本综述中，我们系统梳理了UOGD的环境、经济和人为影响，并考虑了这些议题的多种方法路径。我们总结了经济学及相关领域学术文献的现状与结论，同时提出了未来研究的建议方向。因果推断将继续对评估UOGD的成本与收益具有重要意义。我们的结论是，当前的经济、全球和健康形势可能要求研究人员在可能出现的页岩气衰退背景下，重新审视相关结局。

title: Health and Charge Benefits from Decreasing PM2.5 Concentrations in New York State: Effects of Changing Compositions
venue: Atmospheric Pollution Research, Vol 12, Issue 3, March 2021
abstract: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in New York State declined significantly between 2005 and 2016. Fewer hospitalizations and emergency department (ED) visits for cardiovascular diseases (CVD), respiratory diseases (RD), and respiratory infections (RI) were also observed. However, increased per unit mass toxicity of the remaining PM2.5 was observed. In this study, the changes in hospitalizations and ED visits have been assessed by comparing the PM2.5 and source specific PM2.5 excess risk (ER) relationships between 2005-2007 and 2014–2016 yielded reductions of ~27,000, 2600, and 4251 hospitalizations per year for CVD, RD, and RI, and charge savings of ~613, 41, and 41 million dollars, respectively. However, period specific ER values estimated lower health and cost benefits. For some diseases, hospitalizations increased with increased healthcare costs. Using the whole-period source-specific PM2.5 ER values, the number of hospitalizations decreased by ~13,500 and ~19,000 for CVD and RD but increased by ~800 for RI. Larger period specific ER values for RD shifted from net decreases to net increases in ED visits. Costs followed the numbers of hospitalizations and ED visits and produced increased charges of ~$284 million. County average costs for disease specific hospitalizations and ED visits were used with county specific ER values to estimate those costs. There were increased ED visit costs for some health outcomes. Thus, further action is required to address changes in composition as well as further reductions in concentrations will be needed to address changes in composition and to provide additional public health gains.
abstract_zh: 纽约州PM2.5浓度下降的健康与费用效益：化学成分变化的影响。2005至2016年间，纽约州细颗粒物（PM2.5）显著下降。心血管疾病（CVD）、呼吸系统疾病（RD）和呼吸道感染（RI）所致的住院和急诊就诊人次也有所减少。然而，剩余PM2.5的单位质量毒性有所增加。在本研究中，我们通过比较2005至2007年与2014至2016年间的PM2.5及特定来源PM2.5的超额风险（ER）关系，评估了住院和急诊就诊的变化。结果显示，心血管疾病、呼吸系统疾病和呼吸道感染每年分别减少约27,000、2,600和4,251例住院，节省的费用分别约为6.13亿、4,100万和4,100万美元。然而，分时段的ER估计值所得出的健康与费用效益较低。对于部分疾病，住院人次增加并伴随医疗费用上升。使用全时段特定来源PM2.5的ER值，心血管疾病和呼吸系统疾病的住院人次分别减少约13,500和19,000例，但呼吸道感染住院人次增加约800例。呼吸系统疾病在分时段ER值下的较大变化，使急诊就诊人次由净减少转为净增加。费用随住院和急诊就诊人次变化，并产生约2.84亿美元的费用增加。我们使用各县特定疾病的住院和急诊就诊平均费用，结合各县特定的ER值，估算了这些费用。部分健康结局的急诊费用有所增加。因此，需要采取进一步行动来应对成分结构的变化，并需要进一步降低浓度，以应对成分变化并带来更多的公共健康收益。

title: Assessing the Effectiveness of Vehicle Emission Regulations on Improving Perinatal Health: A Population-Based Accountability Study
abstract:
Since the 1990s, extensive regulations to reduce traffic-related air pollution (TRAP) have been implemented, yet the effectiveness of these regulations has not been assessed with respect to improving infant health. In this study, we evaluate how infant health risks associated with maternal residences near highways during pregnancy have changed over time.
We created a population-based retrospective birth cohort with geocoded residential addresses in Texan metropolitan areas from 1996 through 2009 (n = 2 259 411). We compared term birthweight (37–42 weeks of gestation) among maternal residences <300 m from a highway (high TRAP exposure) (n = 394 346) and 500–3500 m from a highway (comparison group) (n = 1 865 065). We implemented linear regressions to evaluate interactions between high TRAP exposure and birth year, adjusting for demographics, socioeconomic status and neighbourhood context. In addition, we used propensity score matching to further reduce residual confounding.
From 1996 to 2009, outdoor NO2 decreased by 51.3%, based on regulatory monitoring data in Texas. Among pregnant women who resided in the high TRAP zone during pregnancy, interaction terms between residential location and birth year show that birthweight increased by 1.1 g [95% confidence interval CI): 0.7, 1.5) in unadjusted models and 0.3 g (95% CI: 0.0, 0.6) in matched models. Time-stratified models also show decreasing impacts of living in high TRAP areas on birthweight when comparing infants born in 1996–97 with 2008–09. Sensitivity analyses with alternative exposure and control groups show consistent results.
Infant health risks associated with maternal residence near highways have reduced over time, paralleling regulatory measures to improve exhaust pipe emissions.
abstract_zh:
评估机动车排放法规对改善围产期健康的有效性。自20世纪90年代以来，各项减少交通相关空气污染（TRAP）的广泛法规相继实施，但这些法规在改善婴儿健康方面的有效性尚未得到评估。在本研究中，我们评估了孕期居住在高速公路附近的母亲所面临的婴儿健康风险如何随时间变化。
方法：我们在得克萨斯州大都市地区构建了一个基于人群的回顾性出生队列，包含地理编码的居住地址，时间跨度为1996至2009年（n = 2,259,411）。我们比较了居住在距高速公路小于300米（高TRAP暴露）（n = 394,346）与距高速公路500至3500米（对照组）（n = 1,865,065）的母亲所生足月婴儿（妊娠37至42周）的出生体重。我们采用线性回归，评估高TRAP暴露与出生年份之间的交互作用，并对人口学特征、社会经济地位和社区环境进行了调整。此外，我们采用倾向评分匹配，以进一步降低残余混杂。
结果：根据得克萨斯州的监管监测数据，1996至2009年间，室外二氧化氮（NO2）下降了51.3%。在孕期居住于高TRAP区域的孕妇中，居住地与出生年份的交互项显示，未调整模型中出生体重增加1.1克［95%置信区间（CI）：0.7，1.5］，匹配模型中增加0.3克（95% CI：0.0，0.6）。分时段模型也显示，比较1996至1997年与2008至2009年出生的婴儿时，居住在高TRAP地区对出生体重的影响有所减弱。采用替代暴露组和对照组的敏感性分析结果一致。
结论：随着时间推移，与母亲居住地邻近高速公路相关的婴儿健康风险有所降低，这与改善尾气排放的监管措施相吻合。

Shale Gas Development and Drinking Water Quality
venue: American Economic Review, vol. 107, no. 5, May 2017
abstract: Recent studies have linked shale gas development (SGD) to ground water contamination. The extent of these environmental externalities, to date, remains uncertain. To address this gap, we examine whether shale gas development systematically affects drinking water quality by creating a novel dataset that relates SGD to public drinking water samples in Pennsylvania. Our difference-in-differences strategy finds evidence that additional well pads drilled within 1 kilometer of a community water system intake increases shale gas-related contaminants in drinking water. These results are striking considering that our data are based on water sampling measurements taken after municipal treatment.
abstract_zh: 页岩气开发与饮用水质量。近期研究已将页岩气开发（SGD）与地下水污染联系起来。迄今为止，这些环境外部性的程度仍不确定。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了一个新的数据集，将SGD与宾夕法尼亚州的公共饮用水采样数据相联系，考察页岩气开发是否系统性地影响饮用水质量。我们的双重差分策略发现，在社区供水系统取水口1公里范围内每新增一个井场，都会增加饮用水中与页岩气相关的污染物。考虑到我们的数据基于市政处理后的水样测量，这些结果尤为引人注目。

School Food Environments and Policies in US Public Schools
abstract:
OBJECTIVE. The purpose of this study was to describe school food environments and policies in US public schools and how they vary according to school characteristics.
METHODS. We analyzed cross-sectional data from the third School Nutrition and Dietary Assessment study by using a nationally representative sample of 395 US public schools in 129 school districts in 38 states. These 2005 data included school reports of foods and beverages offered in the National School Lunch Program and on-site observations, in a subsample of schools, of competitive foods and beverages (those sold in vending machines and a la carte and that are not part of the National School Lunch Program). Seventeen factors were used to characterize school lunches, competitive foods, and other food-related policies and practices. These factors were used to compute the food environment summary score (0 [least healthy] to 17 [most healthy]) of each school.
RESULTS. There were vending machines in 17%, 82%, and 97% of elementary, middle, and high schools, respectively, and a la carte items were sold in 71%, 92%, and 93% of schools, respectively. Among secondary schools with vending and a la carte sales, these sources were free of low-nutrient energy-dense foods or beverages in 15% and 21% of middle and high schools, respectively. The food environment summary score was significantly higher (healthier) in the lower grade levels. The summary score was not associated with the percentage of students that was certified for free or reduced-price lunches or the percentage of students that was a racial/ethnic minority.
CONCLUSIONS. As children move to higher grade levels, their school food environments become less healthy. The great majority of US secondary schools sell items a la carte in the cafeteria and through vending machines, and these 2 sources often contain low-nutrient, energy-dense foods and beverages, commonly referred to as junk food.
abstract_zh:
美国公立学校的食品环境与政策。目的：本研究旨在描述美国公立学校的食品环境和政策，以及它们如何因学校特征而异。
方法：我们分析了第三次学校营养与膳食评估研究的横截面数据，所用样本为具有全国代表性的395所美国公立学校，来自38个州的129个学区。这些2005年的数据包括学校报告的国家学校午餐计划中提供的食品和饮料，以及在部分学校样本中对竞争性食品和饮料（即通过自动售货机和单点销售、且不属于国家学校午餐计划的食品）进行的现场观察。我们使用17项因素来描述学校午餐、竞争性食品和其他食品相关政策与实践。这些因素用于计算每所学校的食品环境综合得分（0［最不健康］至17［最健康］）。
结果：在小学、初中和高中中，分别有17%、82%和97%的学校设有自动售货机；分别有71%、92%和93%的学校提供单点销售食品。在同时开展自动售货和单点销售的中学和高中中，这些来源中不含低营养高能量食品或饮料的比例分别为15%和21%。低年级学校的食品环境综合得分显著更高（更健康）。该综合得分与获得免费或减价午餐资格的学生比例以及少数族裔学生比例均无关联。
结论：随着儿童升入更高年级，其学校食品环境变得越来越不健康。绝大多数美国中学在食堂单点销售食品，并通过自动售货机销售，而这两种来源常含有低营养、高能量食品和饮料，即通常所说的垃圾食品。
